stressNotes.fast_recovery: Quick recovery after pumping stops; aquifer shows good local transmissivity.
stressNotes.moderate_drawdown: Moderate drawdown with steady recovery within typical resting hours.
stressNotes.sluggish_recovery: Sluggish recovery; water table takes more than 18 hours to stabilize.
stressNotes.severe_drawdown: Deep drawdown under typical pumping; high local cone of depression.
